audit-log.integrity-seal-missing-detail: The audit log's integrity seal is missing. History up to {{timestamp}} can no longer be cryptographically verified. The log may have been truncated.
audit-log.integrity-seal-missing-detail-notime: The audit log's integrity seal is missing. Its history can no longer be cryptographically verified. The log may have been truncated.
audit-log.repair-confirm-body: The integrity seal is missing, so the entries recorded before now can no longer be checked for completeness. Repairing does not recover anything that may have been removed. It re-seals the surviving entries and permanently records a note that this happened. This cannot be undone. Continue?
audit-log.repair-failed: Repair failed. The audit log is unchanged and still needs repair. Please try again.
